title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 10: Saul's last battle against the Philistines on Mount Gilboa, his death, and why the kingdom passed to David.

questions.text: Where did the men of Israel fall slain before the Philistines?
questions.explanation: The men of Israel fled from before the Philistines and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

questions.text: Which sons of Saul did the Philistines kill?
questions.explanation: The Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

questions.text: Who overtook Saul in the battle?
questions.explanation: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him, and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

questions.text: Why would Saul's armor bearer not thrust him through?
questions.explanation: Saul asked his armor bearer to thrust him through, but he would not, for he was terrified.

answers.text: He did not hear the king

questions.text: What did the armor bearer do when he saw that Saul was dead?
questions.explanation: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.

answers.text: He carried the news to David
He fell on his sword and died

questions.text: Where did the Philistines fasten Saul's head?
questions.explanation: They put his armor in the house of their gods and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

questions.text: Where did the valiant men of Jabesh bury the bones of Saul and his sons?
questions.explanation: The valiant men took the bodies to Jabesh and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh.

questions.text: How long did the men of Jabesh fast after the burial?
questions.explanation: After burying the bones under the oak in Jabesh, they fasted seven days.

questions.text: Besides not keeping Yahweh's word, what else did Saul do according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: Saul died for his trespass against Yahweh, because he did not keep Yahweh's word and because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit.

answers.text: He built an altar to Dagon
He asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit
He killed the priests of Yahweh
He made a treaty with the Philistines

questions.text: To whom did Yahweh turn the kingdom over?
questions.explanation: Saul did not inquire of Yahweh, so he killed him and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.
